name: Alana Kusuma
source:
Alana is an Interpol agent who happens to be Damien Nazario's ex-coworker and ex-girlfriend. She is [spoiler]one of your love interests[/spoiler] in Book 2. She is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 11.

Alana initially shows a hostile personality, wanting your character and their friends to leave the Berlin Safe House. She later allows them to stay, though only for a night. It is hinted that she is corrupt, as Damien states that a lot of her methods are illegal and she only cares for herself.

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Alana_Kusuma]Wiki[/url]]
